{{Quote|I recognize a Solo Slide when I see one, Grandma. Don't try to put me off with flattery.|Allana Solo to Leia Organa Solo|<ref name="Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>}}
The '''Solo Slide''' was known for describing one of two things: either an evasive piloting tactic using [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] to maneuver at short notice and near pin point accuracy, or a discussion tactic in which one party attempts to change the discussion by flattering the other party.<ref name="Abyss" />
